Common Questions

Before You Order Quick Answers.

Do I need my own WhatsApp number?

Yes — for a WhatsApp bot you use your own WhatsApp Business number. You connect it yourself through Meta in a few minutes; I never ask for your password or OTP. For a website bot, no number is needed at all.

What do you need from me to start?

Just your business details: name, product prices, delivery information, shop timings, and the questions customers ask you again and again. That's enough for me to train the bot.

How long does it take?

Basic takes about 3 days, Standard about 5 days and Premium about 7 days — the same delivery times as my Fiverr packages.

Can the bot reply in Roman Urdu?

Yes. My bots can answer in English, Roman Urdu, or a mix — whichever your customers actually type. The Style Shop demo does exactly this.

What if the bot can't answer something?

No bot knows everything. I train it on your real FAQs, and for anything outside that, it politely guides the customer to contact you directly instead of making up an answer.
